question: When is a teacher called accomplished and liberated?
premises: All appearances may be equally constructed.
A teacher may embody the flashing forth of unity.
Such unity makes the teacher one in nature.
inference: When a teacher embodies the flashing forth of unity amid equally constructed appearances, that teacher is called accomplished and liberated.
plain_english: Even when all things are equally constructed, a teacher whose nature is the flashing forth of unity is called one-natured, accomplished, and liberated.
